honest_position: 6/10 on a 10-task sample that was chosen because earlier policies failed them. This is NOT a reach figure for MiniWob++ (130 tasks) and no percentage should be inferred for the benchmark. The only defensible claims are the per-task results above and the four instrument bugs, each of which was a self-inflicted measurement error rather than a capability limit.
the_pattern_that_has_held_all_session: every time the score moved, it moved because an instrument bug was fixed. Not once did it move because of a better learning mechanism. That is the empirical answer to 'does instant learning close the computer-use gap': on this bench, learning was never what was failing.
